headline: Minister EDGES 🏛️ JLR BOSS 🍆 As THOUSANDS 💼 of JOBS 🪓 Get SLASHED 😩
text:
BUSINESS 🧳 Secretary 📜 Jonathan 🧔 Reynolds is about to MEET 🤝 the bosses 🕴️ of Jaguar 🐆 Land 🏞️ Rover 🚙 and the Unite 🤝 union 🏭 to discuss 💬 the impact 💥 of thousands 🔢 expected job ✂️ cuts 🩸 at the car 🏎️ maker 🏗️!! This early 🕒 next week 📅 meeting 🪑 will focus 🔎 on ways 🛤️ to mitigate 🛡️ any job losses 😢 but Reynolds straight up 🗣️ ruled 🚫 out a bailout 💰 for the company 🏢 as he told 📢 the BBC 📺's Sunday ☀️ with Laura 🧑‍💼 Kuenssberg that a firm 📊 the size 📏 of JLR 🏎️ which is a huge 🇬🇧 British success 🏆 story 📖 will see its workforce 👷‍♂️ numbers 📉 change 🔄 at various times ⏰ in its business 💼 cycle ♻️ if it's about making 🛠️ sure the workforce 🧑‍🔧 is right ✅ to make the business 🏭 as competitive 🥇 as possible 🌟 that's the conversation 🗣️ we need 🥺 to have!! "A company 🏢 the size 📏 of JLR 🏎️ which is a huge 🇬🇧 British success 🏆 story 📖 at various times ⏰ in its business 💼 cycle ♻️ the number 📊 of directly 👉 people 👥 it employs 💼 will change 🔄" he said 🗣️ while edging 🖐️ closer to long-term 💼 investment 💰 in the future 🔮 of the thirsty 🥵 British car 🏎️ giant 🦸!!

JLR 🏎️ confirmed ✅ to the BBC 📺 it is opening 🚪 a voluntary 🙋 redundancy ✂️ programme 📋 a year 📅 on from a cyber 🕵️‍♂️ attack ⚔️ which brought production 🏭 to a halt 🛑 for more than a month 📆!! The company 🏢 did not confirm 📝 the numbers 🔢 but the Times 🗞️ reported 📰 as many as 4000 🧮 jobs 🪑 may be lost 🥲 due to the impact 💥 of tariffs 📉 and a drop 📉 in sales 💸!! Reynolds 🧔 told 📢 the BBC 📺 that there would be no support 🤝 if it's to bail 💰 people 👥 out 🚪 but opened 🚪 the door 🚪 to a long-term ⏳ investment 💰 in the future 🔮 of the company 🏢 as he spoke 🗣️ with West Midlands 🏙️ mayor 👔 Richard 🧔 Parker about supporting 🛟 the business 🏭 and its staff 👷!! The Liberal 🗳️ Democrats 🗳️ said the news 📰 would be devastating 💥 for JLR 🏎️ staff 👷 and called 📞 for Healey 🧔 to use his speech 🗣️ to offer 🤲 support 🛟 for those jobs 🪑 at risk ⚠️!! "This development 🧱 lays bare 🌳 that the government's 🏛️ growth 📈 mission 🚀 is falling 🥀 far short 📏" the party's 🏛️ business 🏢 spokesperson 🗣️ Sarah 🧑‍💼 Olney said 🗣️ while the whole automotive 🚗 sector feels like it's getting railed 🚂 by a perfect 🌪️ storm ⛈️ under successive governments 🏛️!!

The cuts ✂️ come as Chancellor 💼 John 🧔 Healey is preparing 🍳 to deliver 📦 a speech 🗣️ in the Midlands 🏞️ on Monday 📅 promising 🤝 to boost 📈 economic 💰 growth 🌱 by changing 🔄 how the government 🏛️ values 💎 investment 💰 in infrastructure 🏗️ such as transport 🚚 and housing 🏠!! JLR 🏎️ is based 🏠 in Coventry 🏙️ in the West Midlands 🏞️ and employs 👷 about 30000 🧮 people 👥 in its UK 🇬🇧 operations 🏭 with approximately 10000 🧮 people 👥 employed 💼 at plants 🌱 overseas 🌍!! The cyber 🕵️‍♂️ attack ⚔️ in September 📅 2025 led to the shutdown 🛑 of all manufacturing 🏭 at JLR 🏎️ for several weeks 📆 meaning not a single 🚗 vehicle rolled 🌀 off its production 🏭 lines 📏!! That led to a 27% 📉 drop 📉 in overall production 🏭 at the company 🏢 which is one of the West Midlands' 🏞️ biggest employers 👷 and the overall cost 💰 of the cyber-attack 🕵️‍♂️ and the subsequent loss 😢 of manufacturing 🏭 was estimated 📊 to be 1.9bn 💷!! In June 📅 the firm 🏢 announced 📢 it planned to cut ✂️ about 1.7bn 💷 in costs 💰 over the coming years 📅 to help 🛟 towards its recovery 🩹 from the attack ⚔️ as JLR 🏎️ had indicated 🧭 at the time ⏰ that it would make the savings 💰 through cuts ✂️ in areas 🗺️ such as materials 🧱 warranty 📜 and fixed costs 💰 while the JLR 🏎️ hack 🕵️‍♂️ is the costliest 💸 cyber attack ⚔️ in UK 🇬🇧 history 📜 analysts 📊 say!!

JLR 🏎️ has not confirmed ✅ the scale 📏 of the job ✂️ cuts ✂️ but said they would simplify 🧹 the business 🏭 and improve 📈 efficiency ⚙️ and build 🛠️ greater resilience 🛡️!! "Today 📅 we informed 📢 our colleagues 👥 and trade union 🤝 partners 👫 that JLR 🏎️ is opening 🚪 a voluntary 🙋 redundancy ✂️ programme 📋 offering 👐 salaried 💼 and management 👔 team 👥 members the opportunity 🚪 to leave 🚪 the business 🏭" a spokesperson 🗣️ said 🗣️!! "We will share 📤 further information 📜 with our colleagues 👥 first 🥇" it did not rule 🚫 out the prospect 🔮 of some compulsory ⛓️ redundancies ✂️ as part 📍 of the plans 📋 while Unite 🤝 general secretary 📜 Sharon 👩 Graham said the union 🤝 had been warning ⚠️ about a perfect 🌪️ storm ⛈️ hanging 🪝 over the automotive 🚗 industry 🏭 for some time ⏰!! "Death ☠️ by a thousand cuts ✂️ has been going on under the nose 👃 of successive governments 🏛️" she said 🗣️ adding there had been intensive 🔥 discussions 🗣️ over the weekend 🌴 about mitigating 🛡️ job losses 😢 as the whole thing feels like the industry 🚗 is getting edged 🖐️ to the brink 🌊 by tariffs 📉 sales 📉 drops 📉 and that nasty cyber 🕵️‍♂️ pounding 💥 from last year 📅!!

Reynolds 🧔 was asked ❓ about the impact 💥 on the car 🚗 industry 🏭 of the UK's 🇬🇧 electric ⚡ vehicle 🚙 sales 💸 target 🎯 which means manufacturers 🏭 must ensure 📌 a percentage 📊 of the cars 🚗 they sell 💸 each year 📅 are zero emissions 🌬️ with the target 🎯 rising 📈 each year 📅 to reach 80% 📈 by 2030 📅!! He said one of the first 🥇 things he had done ✅ as business 🏢 secretary 📜 was give the industry 🏭 more flexibility 🧘 to work 🛠️ towards that and said there was a further consultation 🗣️ open 🚪 on it!! "It's not where it needs 🥺 to be and that's why we're willing 🙇 to change 🔄 the regulation 📜 to work 🛠️ with where consumer 🛍️ demand 📈 is and the industry 🏭" he added 🗣️ while he had also spoken 🗣️ with West Midlands 🏞️ mayor 👔 Richard 🧔 Parker about supporting 🛟 the business 🏭 and its staff 👷!! JLR 🏎️ in July 📅 said fewer than 300 🧮 people 👥 would leave 🚪 the firm 🏢 under cost 💰 savings 💰 plans 📋 announced 📢 at the time ⏰ as the voluntary 🙋 redundancy ✂️ programme 📋 offers 👐 salaried 💼 and management 👔 team members the chance 🎲 to bounce 🏀 while not ruling out compulsory ⛓️ cuts ✂️ either!! The meeting 🤝 with the JLR 🏎️ boss 🕴️ and Unite 🤝 is set to get spicy 🌶️ as they hunt 🕵️ for ways to keep this British 🏴󠁧󠁢󠁥󠁮󠁧󠁿 success 🏆 story 📖 from getting absolutely COOKED 🍳 by the perfect storm ⛈️!!
